notes.title: 0.9 Update - "Tower of Quality"
notes.notes:
Greetings!

It has been a long while since there was an update, but the development never stopped! So here we are, with a new update and new cool stuff to play with! Let's dive in! ^_^

Update 0.9:
- New filters for retro style visuals - TV Grain, Bloom, Terminal (Green and Orange). Can be toggled in Options!
- New mode for upgrades - Randomised! Stops blocking your game to select an upgrade and gives you a random one! Can be toggled in Options and  is on by Default!
- Tab now brings up your active upgrades.
- Extra upgrade to make the game Harder.
- Extra upgrade to increase the exp collection range.
- 4 turret types are available in game - Laser, Missile, Grenade, Beam
- Turrets require you to select the Manufacturing Upgrade and then a corresponding ability - Laser Shot, Guided Missile, Grenade, Beam

As well as smaller bugs and fixes not worth mentioning!

As always, there is more to come! Thank you for your interest in Spaceborne Survivors and stay tuned for more! :)

notes.title: 0.8 Update - Overhaul
notes.notes:
Greetings!

I have gone away on a vacation and came back refreshed and with a few ideas for the updates to the game! In fact the amount of changes and reworks is substantial enough to consider this an "overhaul" of the game, one which y'all hopefully enjoy. Let's dive in! ^_^

Additions:
- Character stats
    - Each character now has unique stats - HP, Speed, Collection Range, Acceleration
- New Character - Drone Queen
    - Lower HP, but vastly bigger collection range and starts with a laser drone
- Drone Abilities
    - 5 drone types are available in game - Heal, Laser, Missile, Mortar, Ram
- Ability Evolution
    - Apart from the Heal Drone that is available instantly other drone types require you to select the Healing drone and then a corresponding ability - Laser Shot, Guided Missile, Grenade, Magnetic Shield

Optimisation i.e. fixes:
- The experience pick-ups now have an outline so that they don't blend visually
- In "Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma" and "Zeta" sectors enemy Boss spawns are no longer limited by a chance in a certain time period, instead they start spawning after a certain time to provide pressure on the player.

Changes:
- Upgrades concerning in-session abilities have been moved to the in-session part. That way you build up to be a mecha machine of destruction during the session itself, but start with such immense power. 
- Missile ability that used to circle around the player is now the Ram Drone ability.
- Whirlwind has been changed to be mouse guided
- "Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma" and "Zeta" sectors are locked behind the enemy kill counts.
- "Boss Rush" Mode Characters can be unlocked in the "Upgrades" section
- "Zen" Mode requires 2 victories in any mode
- Enemy howitzer attack reduced from 2 damage to 1.

There is more to come! Thank you for your interest in Spaceborne Survivors and stay tuned for more! :)

notes.title: 0.75 Update - Optimisation and Abilities
notes.notes:
Greetings!

After the release I managed to get some feedback from the players that were kind enough to reach out and share it with me. I'm very grateful for the interest in my game and I hope to bring you more cool stuff! However, patch notes must be addressed first! ^_^

Optimisations i.e. fixes:
- Sprite scaling for Enemies
- Sprite scaling for Player Characters
- Sprite scaling for Pickups
- Sprite scaling for Beam, Missile, Laser

Changes:
- Dash speed increased from 600 to 700
- Dash duration increased from 0.2 to 0.3
- Beam Attack increased to 10
- Missile Attack increased to 7
- Hero progression now is not locked per level, but rather opening a Hero now opens it for all levels.
- Regeneration has been lowered form 30 sec intervals to 5 sec intervals
- Soundtrack reworked (only personally composed tracks now)
- Damage numbers given a red outline for better visibility

Additions:
- Controller support
- SteamDeck seems to be working (3 customers have verified that the game launches)
- The mouse-dependent ability may require setting your mode to Windowed via in-game "Options" Menu
- In one instance the game has launched only after first being launched via the "Proton Experimental" option, and then launched normally.
- Guiding Missile Ability Added (follows you mouse)
- Grenade Launcher Ability Added

There is more to come! Thank you for your interest in Spaceborne Survivors and stay tuned for more! :)
